resources.name: Coupon Service
resources.description:
Auto-generated from OpenAPI on dotnet build.

Swagger / Redoc-style browsing: import insomnia/*-design.insomnia.json as a Design Document.
Try-it-out requests: use the Coupon Service / Order API folders below.

Regenerate: dotnet build or scripts/sync-insomnia-from-openapi.ps1

resources.name: Documentation (Swagger / Redoc preview)
resources.description:
Open these design specs in Insomnia for a rendered OpenAPI preview.

Import each *-design.insomnia.json file as a Design Document, then use the Design tab.
From the design document: Settings → Generate collection → Debug tab to send requests.

resources.name: Coupon Service
resources.description: Dedicated /v1 routes for Coupon Service. Edit insomnia/routes/coupon-service.routes.json to add routes.

resources.name: Preview
resources.description: Advisory pricing — never writes (AC-1.6).

resources.name: POST /v1/coupons/preview — SAVE10 applied
resources.description: AC-1.1: valid coupon returns subtotal, discount, total, and per-line allocations.

resources.name: POST /v1/coupons/preview — minimum not met
resources.description: AC-1.2 / AC-1.3: HTTP 200 with status Rejected, reason, near-miss hint, full-price breakdown.

resources.name: POST /v1/coupons/preview — expired coupon
resources.description: HTTP 200 with reason Expired — rejection is a business outcome, not an error.

resources.name: Health
resources.description: Liveness and readiness probes.

resources.name: GET /v1/health/live
resources.description: Anonymous liveness probe.

resources.name: GET /v1/health/ready
resources.description: Readiness probe — includes policy repository check.

resources.name: Reservations
resources.description: Internal ingress only — requires Coupon.Redeem (Order API managed identity).

resources.name: POST /v1/reservations — reserve
resources.description: Authoritative re-price and reserve.

resources.name: POST /v1/reservations/{orderId}/confirm
resources.description: Confirm reservation — idempotent.

resources.name: POST /v1/reservations/{orderId}/release
resources.description: Release reservation — idempotent.

resources.name: Admin — Policies
resources.description: Requires Coupon.Admin role.

resources.name: GET /v1/admin/policies
resources.description: List policies.

resources.name: POST /v1/admin/policies
resources.description: Create policy — validated against engine manifest.

resources.name: GET /v1/admin/policies/{policyId}
resources.description: Read a policy by id.

resources.name: PUT /v1/admin/policies/{policyId}
resources.description: Update policy — requires If-Match ETag header.

resources.name: DELETE /v1/admin/policies/{policyId}
resources.description: Archive policy (soft delete).

resources.name: POST /v1/admin/policies/{policyId}/simulate
resources.description: Dry run against a sample cart — returns trace.

resources.name: POST /v1/admin/policies/{policyId}/status
resources.description: Promote lifecycle: Draft, Shadow, Active, Paused, Archived.

resources.name: Policy Engine
resources.description: Engine manifest for admin tooling.

resources.name: GET /v1/policy-engine/manifest
resources.description: Facts, operators, effects, and limits.
